description:
NAVSUP Fleet Logistics Center Puget Sound intends to solicit and award a firm-fixed-price Supply-type Purchase Order for OEM CIRCOR NAVAL SOLUTIONS LLC DBA WARREN PUMPS Main Circulating Pump Parts on a SOLE SOURCE basis. 

See attached solicitation posted 27 MAR 2026 for requirements. All responses shall be submitted prior to the solicitation closing date on page 1, box 8.
